PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Richard Lewis, Chair  Michael Clemson, Commissioner
Jane Templin, Vice Chair  Josh LaFarga, Commissioner
Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Michele Ware, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:01 PM, Chair Lewis called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Castillo, Clemson, Ware, Templin, Lewis

Commissioners Absent: LaFarga

Also present: Erin Weesner-McKinley, Deputy City Attorney, Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau
Manager, Maryanne Cronin, Zoning Administration Officer, Alex Medina, Bureau Secretary,
Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

Chair Lewis spoke; and announced that Comissioner LaFarga was excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Vice Chair Templin led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55758  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Clemson, seconded by Vice Chair
  Templin, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Castillo, Clemson, Ware, Templin, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  LaFarga

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, spoke; and provided the Director’s
  Report.

  Page 1 of 5

2.  24-55757  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of

  area to accommodate an onsite tasting area (ABC Type 86 - Instructional Tasting
